name: ReMorphed
summary: Kill a mob to unlock its form, then transform into it from a menu. Each form has its own model, traits (such as swimming faster as a fish) and sometimes an ability. Built on Walkers and CraftedCore.

mechanics.title: Unlocking morphs
mechanics.description: Killing a mob saves it to your collection. Walkers' own unlock method is disabled while ReMorphed is installed.

mechanics.title: Balance
mechanics.description: Unlocked mobs "vanish" after being morphed into 5 times per kill, so repeated morphing needs further kills.

mechanics.title: Traits and abilities
mechanics.description: Each form has passive traits (symbols shown in the menu) and some forms have an active ability with a cooldown indicator in the bottom-right.

mechanics.title: Variants
mechanics.description: Open the variants menu to pick a variant of a mob; scroll the mouse wheel to cycle and press the key again to confirm.

mechanics.title: Players
mechanics.description: Morphing into other players requires the separate SkinShifter mod (not confirmed in the pack).

commands_and_keybinds: G - transform into the selected morph
A help screen is available (remorphed.help keybind)
getting_started: Kill a mob, press ^ to open the menu, select the form and press G.
editor_notes: Keybinds from the mod description and help text; confirm in-game. No pack config override exists.
